submitted.rationale: Zn–Sb–O phases (Zn7Sb2O12, ZnSb2O6, ZnO) have band gaps of roughly 3.2–3.5 eV, so 2.4 eV illumination falls below the gap. Every measured EQE was close to zero (~1e-3 %), about what measurement noise would give. The Sb-rich end (index 27, Sb 0.81) gave the highest reading (0.0049 %), possibly because of a lower-gap Sb oxide such as Sb2O4 or Sb6O13. The differences between compositions are marginal.

rejected.reason: ZnSb2O6 region, EQE -0.0006%, wide gap, not absorbing at 2.4 eV
